`resource.kubernetes_storage_class_v1.gp3` declares `storage_provisioner = "ebs.csi.aws.com"` but has no dependency on the self-managed EBS CSI driver (`module.aws_ebs_csi_driver` → `helm_release.addon`, enabled via `enable_self_managed_aws_ebs_csi_driver = true`). Terraform can create the storage class before the driver is installed, leaving PVCs that reference the `gp3` class stuck pending until the driver's pods are running. A `depends_on` on the helm_release is needed.

`resource.kubernetes_storage_class_v1.efs` declares `storage_provisioner = "efs.csi.aws.com"` and is wired to the EFS filesystem (`fileSystemId = module.efs.id`), but has no dependency on the EFS CSI driver (`module.aws_efs_csi_driver` → `helm_release.addon`, enabled via `enable_aws_efs_csi_driver = true`). The storage class object will be created (ordering-wise it is tied only to the filesystem) before the CSI driver exists, so dynamic provisioning through it fails until the driver's IRSA service account and pods are ready. A `depends_on` on the helm_release is needed.

`module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng` has an explicit `depends_on` on `resource.aws_iam_role.managed_ng`, but the role is already an implicit dependency via `node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn`. The `depends_on` entry for the role is redundant (the entries for the instance profile and the role policy attachment are not, and should stay).

`module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy` has an explicit `depends_on` on `resource.aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution`, but the role is already an implicit dependency because the local-exec command references `aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id`. The explicit `depends_on` entry is redundant.

`module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy` has an explicit `depends_on` on `resource.kubernetes_namespace.spark`, but the namespace is already an implicit dependency because the local-exec command references `kubernetes_namespace.spark.id`. The explicit `depends_on` entry is redundant.
